title: Where Are We Meeting? Reviewing Location Suffixes

sections.content: This lesson pulls together the location patterns from earlier units: Hol találkozunk? asks where, and the answer often uses the superessive -n, as with téren ('on the square') from Unit 27.

items.english: At the square. That's the plan.

sections.content: Ez a program is a neat zero-copula sentence summing up a plan: 'ez' (this) + 'a program' (the plan), no van needed, exactly like every other identity statement in this course.
